metrics.claimsTooltip: Total amount paid out to settle insurance claims. Monitor for sudden spikes

metrics.averageLossRatioTooltip: Weighted average of loss ratios across all product lines. Lower indicates better underwriting performance
metrics.totalPremiumsTooltip: Sum of all premiums collected across all insurance products and regions
metrics.totalClaimsTooltip: Total amount paid out for all settled claims across the portfolio
metrics.claimsCountTooltip: Total number of claims filed. Track against historical averages for anomaly detection
metrics.avgClaimSizeTooltip: Average payout per claim. Large deviations may indicate fraud or catastrophic events
metrics.policyCountTooltip: Total number of active insurance policies in force across all product lines
